## README.md
# AI4SmallFarms Field Boundaries with ML Splits

Field boundaries across smallholder farms in Cambodia and Vietnam, with a fixed train/val/test partition for machine learning.

## Contents

- `ai4sf_ml.parquet`, 439,013 polygon features

## Splits

| Split | Features |
| ----- | -------- |
| `train` | 304,784 |
| `val` | 83,069 |
| `test` | 51,160 |
| **total** | **439,013** |

The `split` column carries this partition. Use it as given, so that results stay comparable across models trained on this dataset.

## Format

- GeoParquet 1.1.0, geometry encoded as WKB, all features are Polygons
- Coordinate reference system: EPSG:32648 (WGS 84 / UTM zone 48N)
- Conforms to the fiboa 0.3.0 specification

## Columns

| Column | Notes |
| ------ | ----- |
| `id` | Unique feature identifier |
| `geometry` | Field boundary polygon |
| `group` | Source tile group used when building the splits |
| `split` | Machine learning partition, see above |
| `collection` | Collection identifier carried from the source |
| `admin:country_code` | ISO 3166-1 alpha-2 country code |
| `bbox` | Bounding box struct, enables spatial row group pruning |

## Notes

The `group` column preserves the source tile grouping used when the splits were built. Fields that share a tile stay in the same split, which prevents neighbouring fields from leaking information between training and test.

This dataset is stored in EPSG:32648 rather than EPSG:4326. Reproject before combining it with datasets in geographic coordinates.

## Provenance and licence

- Licence: CC-BY-4.0
- Source data provider: DATA Archiving and Networked Services (DANS)

Please cite the original authors:

> Persello, C., Grift, J., Fan, X., Paris, C., Hansch, R., Koeva, M., & Nelson, A. (2023). AI4SmallFarms: A Dataset for Crop Field Delineation in Southeast Asian Smallholder Farms. IEEE Geoscience and Remote Sensing Letters, 20, 2505705. https://doi.org/10.1109/LGRS.2023.3323095

## Related
